export_approval: User approved 1024x1024 proportional export, with native originals preserved.

00.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single high-resolution tile of a larger camp illustration, square opaque PNG, exactly 1024x1024.

Input image 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET, an exact cropped tile from the selected finished camp scene.
Input image 2 (style-camp.jpg) is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Ignore its layout, trees, tent and object placements.

Redraw this crop of the camp scene at much higher detail in the same UNIFIED STYLE: identical
composition and colors, every object in the same place, crisper edges and richer material detail.
Do not add or remove anything. Same NIGHT lighting.

CRITICAL TILE REGISTRATION: Keep the exact same crop boundaries and framing. This is one of 4 overlapping tiles that must join seamlessly. Keep all large shapes, small flower positions, color regions, object outlines, and edge-crossing contours in identical normalized pixel positions. Do not pan, zoom, rotate, reframe, change perspective or complete any object clipped by the crop. Only improve definition inside existing shapes. Do not introduce any elements from the style reference. If the target contains only grass, return ONLY that same grass and those same tiny flowers, never invent a camp scene, objects, horizon or trees.
Retain the selected art's 2D painted cel-shaded aesthetic; matte illustrated materials, no 3D spherical shading or shiny highlights. Match the input's exact nighttime brightness, saturation, hue, cool blue ambience and painted amber firelight. No new shadows, objects, grass clumps or flower clusters. Preserve silhouettes, keeping the perimeter especially exact. Clean and inviting, subtle refined detail rather than texture noise.

UNIFIED STYLE: hand-painted 2D game illustration, NOT a 3D render — the exact look of the attached style
reference (art/guide/style-camp.jpg): soft painterly cel shading with gentle gradients, rounded simplified
shapes, warm cheerful pastel colors, soft daylight from the upper left, only light ambient occlusion, clean
tidy edges, no hard black outlines. No glossy or plastic materials, no photoreal lighting, no depth of field,
no lens effects, no visible brush texture. No text, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no borders. Everything is
cute, friendly and calm.

NIGHT LIGHTING OVERRIDE: retain the target's exact night illumination; ignore the unified style daylight clause. Do not make this crop daytime or brighter. No 3D render lighting, glossy materials, lens bloom or bokeh.

Night crop 00: upper-left quadrant, with sage tent and its faint warm doorway, forest and sky at top, cool open lawn; only the tripod apex fragment is clipped by LOWER-RIGHT. Keep all exact placements and clipping. Never complete a tripod/fire or insert a pot. Same warm doorway and cool nighttime palette.
00.validation: PASS: exact 1024x1024 square PNG; direct check_painting aspect=1 and minWidth=1024
